spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "process message from VLBA_notif" && span.ngradar.message.name = "PROGRESS_COMPLETE" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: DSOC PROGRESS_COMPLETE consumer span duration. Includes nested synchronous Kafka sends; percentiles are per time bucket.
spec.title: Completed transfer processing duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "process message from VLBA_notif" && span.ngradar.message.name = "VLBA_REQUEST_STORAGE" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: DSOC VLBA_REQUEST_STORAGE consumer span duration, including synchronous Kafka sends.
spec.title: Storage check processing duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "send message to DSOC_notif" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: Application-side time to receive a Kafka delivery callback. Does not include downstream consumption.
spec.title: Kafka delivery duration

spec.description: Rate of VLBA_notif consumer spans, grouped by message name.
spec.title: DSOC messages processed per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "process message from VLBA_notif" && status = error } | rate()

spec.description: Consumer spans marked as errors, including handled verification and image processing failures.

spec.description: 95th percentile duration per child span. Verification includes retries and the VERIFIED Kafka send; storage check measures the capacity scan.

spec.description: Matching child spans; click a Trace ID to inspect their position in the full observation timeline.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name = "process message from GBT_notif" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: UI_EVENT consumer span; includes transmitter state transitions and synchronous Kafka deliveries. Requires the consumer span to end on successful processing.
spec.title: GBT waveform request processing duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name = "process message from GBT_notif" && status = error } | rate()

spec.description: GBT_notif consumer spans marked as errors.
spec.title: GBT processing errors per second

spec.description: Open a Trace ID to inspect GBT processing and nested Kafka sends. Search includes consumer and producer spans.
